title: Analytic: lossy membrane guide, window-averaged mode power and output / input ratio vs frequency
description:
A straight strip guide (membrane on quadratic triangles, h = 3 um) of width W = 78 um clamped on x_lo / x_hi, T = 80 N/m, rho_s = 3.2e-4 kg/m^2 (c = 500 m/s), loss_factor eta = 0.01, between two ports (y_lo sends mode 1 in, both absorb 3 modes exactly). Frequency response 3.5-6 MHz (11 frequencies, between the cutoffs c / 2W = 3.21 MHz and c / W = 6.41 MHz: only mode 1 propagates).
Two mode_projection features with result_axis 'frequency' give mode_1_power = the mean of |a_1|^2 over a window of the guide versus frequency: input_power samples y = 30-80 um (11 points, the whole range averaged), output_power samples 220-290 um (15 points) and averages only 230-280 um (average_start / average_end), so its 11 averaged points are the input points shifted by D = 200 um.
Curves & tables tab: the derived curve power_ratio = output_power:mode_1_power / input_power:mode_1_power with the dotted reference exp(-2 alpha D), alpha = -Im beta, beta^2 = rho_s omega^2 / (T (1 + j eta)) - (pi / W)^2 (a matched lossy guide: |a_1(y)|^2 = A^2 exp(-2 alpha y), so the window means differ by exactly that factor). The ratio peaks near 0.85 at 4.5 MHz (alpha ~ eta k^2 / (2 beta) is smallest at k = sqrt(2) pi / W) and falls to 0.84 at 6 MHz and 0.80 at 3.5 MHz, near cutoff.
Derived values tab: ratio_5MHz from the ratio curve against the same formula.
Expected agreement: about 1e-4 (P2 dispersion O((k h)^4), discrete DtN mismatch of the ports); tolerances are first estimates.

parameters.name: W_guide
parameters.description: guide width between the clamped walls

parameters.name: h_mesh
parameters.description: triangle size (about 30 elements per guide wavelength at 6 MHz)

parameters.name: D_windows
parameters.description: shift between the input and output averaging windows

parameters.name: f_check
parameters.description: frequency of the ratio check (a sample of the sweep)

parameters.name: k2_check
parameters.description: Re of rho_s omega^2 / (T (1 + j eta)) at f_check

parameters.name: alpha_check
parameters.description: attenuation -Im beta of mode 1 at f_check [1/m]

parameters.name: ratio_check
parameters.description: analytic output / input window power ratio at f_check
